title: Low-Sodium Steamed Korean Rice Bowl
description: A traditional Korean dish from the Chungcheong region, featuring a simple yet flavorful steamed rice bowl with a low-sodium twist, using dashi extract and branston pickle.

ingredients.name: Korean short-grain rice (2 cups)
ingredients.notes: Japanese or Calrose rice can be used as substitutes

ingredients.name: Dashi extract (1 tsp)
ingredients.notes: Homemade dashi extract can be used for added flavor

ingredients.name: Branston pickle (2 tbsp)
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste, or omit for a milder flavor

ingredients.name: Salt (to taste, optional)
ingredients.notes: Adjust or omit for a truly low-sodium option

ingredients.name: Scallions (chopped, for garnish)
ingredients.notes: Optional, for added flavor and texture

instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine mesh strainer and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, combine the rice and 4 cups of water.
Add the dashi extract and salt (if using) to the saucepan.
Bring the water to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid.
Steam the rice for 15-20 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed and the rice is cooked through.
Transfer the cooked rice to a mason jar or a small serving bowl.
Stir in the branston pickle until well combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped scallions and toasted sesame seeds, if desired.
